units.label: a
units.text: An appropriate situation for President's Rule: An opposition party professing ultra right views won Assembly elections where as in the Centre a party opposing such views is in power
units.true_fact: Different ideology from the Centre is not a ground (Bommai).
units.subject_rule: Polity: Bommai test - ideology/protests not grounds

units.label: b
units.text: An appropriate situation for President's Rule: The convoy of Governor of the State was obstructed by thousands of people of a village because the Governor's car hit and killed a boy of the village
units.true_fact: A local law-and-order incident is not a breakdown.
units.subject_rule: Polity: Bommai test - ideology/protests not grounds

units.label: c
units.text: An appropriate situation for President's Rule: The State Government is hobnobbing with a neighbouring Country and allowing terrorists to enter India through the border
units.subject_rule: Polity: Bommai test - ideology/protests not grounds

units.label: d
units.text: An appropriate situation for President's Rule: Massive protests were held throughout the State for few months against the new tax policy of the Centre
units.true_fact: Protests against Centre policy are not a ground.
units.subject_rule: Polity: Bommai test - ideology/protests not grounds

solve.steps: Only option c involves the State government itself subverting security; others are politics or protests.
solve.min_knowledge: Bommai: Art. 356 only for genuine breakdown.

units.label: a
units.text: Included in the Constitution: President can suspend some of the Fundamental Rights during emergency
units.subject_rule: Polity: real power vs overstated powers

units.label: b
units.text: Included in the Constitution: Prime Minister can dismiss any Chief Minister
units.true_fact: The PM cannot dismiss a CM; CMs hold office during the Governor's pleasure.
units.subject_rule: Polity: real power vs overstated powers

units.label: c
units.text: Included in the Constitution: States have Power to amend any law enacted by parliament on a subject in Concurrent list with President's assent
units.true_fact: Art. 254(2) lets a State law prevail with assent, not amend any Parliament law.
units.subject_rule: Polity: real power vs overstated powers

units.label: d
units.text: Included in the Constitution: Governor can reserve any Bill for consideration by the President
units.true_fact: Governor can reserve Bills but not "any" in a constitutional mandate sense; Money Bills etc. limited.
units.subject_rule: Polity: real power vs overstated powers

solve.steps: The hedged "some ... during emergency" is safe; options with "any" overstate powers.

doubt: Option d (Governor can reserve any Bill, Art. 200) is arguably also true; a is the clearest key.
